Lot 2 | Shantonagh Lodge | Home & Guest Lodge on c.1 Acre
One of four buying options at Shantonagh Lodge, Lot 2 brings together a three-bedroom home, a separate two-bedroom guest lodge and circa 1 acre of mature grounds. Available on its own or as part of the complete holding.
This is a house where money was spent on what matters.
The main home has three bedrooms and three bathrooms. High ceilings and large sash windows bring light through the house, while original fireplaces, decorative cornices and panelled doors retain much of its character.
The windows themselves tell you something about the standard. Handmade solid teak, double-glazed sash windows are complemented by traditional panelled internal shutters, a detail that runs through much of the house.
The living accommodation is well balanced. There is room to gather and room to get away from it. The main sitting room features a marble fireplace, while the kitchen and dining areas form the everyday heart of the house.
The kitchen has a clean, contemporary finish, with high-quality fitted cabinetry, generous worktop space, a Rangemaster cooker and Belfast sink. White goods are also included in the sale.
Practical upgrades sit quietly behind the character of the house. There is oil-fired central heating, with underfloor heating at ground-floor level and radiators upstairs. Fibre broadband is also available.
Upstairs, there is no drop-off in standard. High ceilings continue through the first floor, alongside traditional-style column radiators and carefully finished bedrooms and bathrooms.
The main bathroom is particularly well done. A freestanding roll-top bath sits at its centre, alongside a separate enclosed shower and double vanity with twin basins. Painted timber wall panelling and traditional fittings complete the room.
The Guest Lodge
Then there is the guest lodge.
Set separately behind the main home, this is not simply an extra room for occasional visitors. It is a self-contained two-bedroom, one-bathroom home with a full kitchen and its own living accommodation.
The main living and dining area has real presence, with a high vaulted ceiling, exposed timber roof trusses and extensive glazing bringing natural light through the room. A freestanding solid-fuel stove provides a natural focal point.
The kitchen is full-size and finished to a strong standard, with fitted cabinetry, generous worktop space and its own Rangemaster cooker.
For extended family, visiting guests or as a potential additional income stream, the lodge gives this property another level of flexibility.
Outside
The house and lodge sit within circa 1 acre of mature grounds.
Established trees and planting provide privacy around the property, while a sheltered courtyard creates a private outdoor space close to the house.
To the south is a further green area with a small number of established apple trees. An old hay shed stands here, together with traditional stone outbuildings previously used for agricultural purposes. While simple in their current form, these buildings provide further possibilities for how this part of the property might be used.
The setting feels established. Trees, gardens, old buildings and the two homes all sit naturally together.
Shantonagh Lodge is approximately 13 km from Castleblayney, 13 km from Carrickmacross and 23 km from Kingscourt, providing straightforward access to shops, schools, services and everyday amenities.
Four Buying Options
Shantonagh Lodge is being offered in four buying options:
Lot 1: The complete holding, including the home, guest lodge and lands
Lot 2: The 3 bedroom home and 2 bedroom guest lodge on circa 1 acre
Lot 3: Circa 23.55 acres of agricultural land
Lot 4: Circa 12.17 acres of agricultural land
Buyers interested in the complete holding or either of the individual land parcels can view the separate listings or contact Keenan Auctioneers for full details and maps.
For further information or to arrange a viewing, contact Keenan Auctioneers on 042 966 7224.
